_readme: Scales. The official CVPR rating wording is not public (OpenReview form is login-gated; see 01_sources/cvpr_official_process.md sec. 2). The default profile uses the only label set on an official 2026 page (CVPR 2026 reviewer training, final-justification examples). The 6-level profile follows forum reports for ICCV 2025 / CVPR 2026. Pick per session with `hx.py new --scale`; never mix profiles within a session.

cvpr26_5.source: CVPR 2026 reviewer training (RT26) final-justification examples; VERIFIED labels, numeric mapping SECONDARY

six_level.source: forum reports for ICCV 2025 and CVPR 2026; SECONDARY

labels.2: Somewhat confident: I may have missed or misread central parts
labels.3: Fairly confident: I understood the main points but did not check every detail
labels.4: Confident: I checked the important details and know the area
labels.5: Certain: I know this area very well and checked the paper carefully

confidence.source: harness wording; CVPR's own wording is NOT FOUND (field confidence_level exists)

section.wording: 1-10, anchors in section_rubrics.md (harness addition, not on the CVPR form)
